checks.detail: every payload-store construction names whether it owns bootstrap authority
invalid enum values cannot fall through as accidental bootstrap permission
normal observation and mutation may reconcile an exact marker but cannot mint one
snapshot and put cannot bypass the same exact identity gate
status, enqueue, and send cannot bind an empty or preseeded payload root
operational configuration rejects copied, tolerant, policy-incompatible, or noncanonical documents
the writer proves size, strict JSON, and UTF-8 compatibility before init mutates stores
an interrupted init may leave stores but cannot claim a committed store set
store paths, local actor, folder, and payload ceiling come only from the committed manifest
the commit marker and database files cannot live inside selected mutable roots
missing or wrong-role authority cannot leave an unreferenced payload object
the manifest reader does not duplicate or inherit the broad crypto/runtime parser implementation
empty, preseeded, restart, and invalid-disposition paths have runtime checks
canonical round trip, copy/tamper/policy/bounds/UTF-8/path failures are executable invariants
the shipped executable proves missing/copy/tamper/mixing/profile/detached-store failures and valid transport
the authority codec, runtime test, publication owner, and source tripwire run in CMake/CTest
a rev0898 package cannot omit the parser, manifest codec, proof, audit, or handoff documents

scope_nonclaim: source spelling and order do not prove path identity, SQLite or filesystem durability, concurrency, crash recovery, or cross-store atomicity
